icon.prompt: Create the Ice Spike magic icon for the same realistic Cold Steel RPG UI series. Image 1 is the exact frame, graphite background, square canvas, brushed silver hexagonal bevel proportions and top-left soft lighting reference. Keep these intact. Replace ONLY its central flaming projectile with a strong large icy blue translucent pointed icicle, angled from lower left to upper right, accompanied by two smaller ice spikes set behind it. Faceted but natural frozen-water surfaces, pale cyan edges, deep glacier blue inner core, fine trapped cracks, white frosty roots. Clearly recognizable spear-shaped ice silhouette even at small hotbar sizes. Image 2 is subject identity reference only, NOT its purple/gold style. No text, no numbers, no snowflake symbols, no environment. No purple, no gold, no flames. Preserve neutral graphite panel and silver frame from image 1. Output a square production icon.

delivery: Necessary builds/imports only; no game test or rendered acceptance.
